### Nextpower to Announce Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results on October 28, 2026


October 7, 2026


FREMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Nextpower](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nextpower.com%2F&esheet=54617970&newsitemid=20261007289103&lan=en-US&anchor=Nextpower&index=1&md5=b021be67c2f9d8d210496f6c24c6c743) (Nasdaq: NXT) will announce its second quarter fiscal 2027 financial results after the market closes on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. The company will hold a conference call to discuss the results on the same day at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time / 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time.


**Q2 FY2027 Earnings Call** October 28, 2026
2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET


Live webcast available on[investors.nextpower.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.nextpower.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54617970&newsitemid=20261007289103&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.nextpower.com&index=2&md5=a66e305f165d5d77775a0b3edac6b3b2)


The webcast replay, along with supporting materials, will be available on the Nextpower investor relations website following the conclusion of the event.


**About Nextpower**


Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT) innovates and delivers integrated technology solutions for modern energy infrastructure. Its solar and energy storage platforms help customers design, build, and operate utility-scale power plants and other critical power infrastructure with faster project delivery, improved system performance, greater reliability, and long-term operational value. Building on more than a decade of energy technology leadership, Nextpower partners with customers worldwide to accelerate the deployment of reliable firm power needed for a rapidly electrifying world. Learn more at[www.nextpower.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nextpower.com&esheet=54617970&newsitemid=20261007289103&lan=en-US&anchor=www.nextpower.com&index=3&md5=bd5e3c51eace559e9e5fb2fe545b768c) .
